words.word: of the high priests and smote off

occurrences.text: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.
words: of the high priests and smote off

occurrences.text: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
